    t() %>%

    rownames_to_column("ID")

```{r limma_differential_analysis}
# perform limma differential analysis
# n_extreme_features controls top and bottom features separately:
# 10 means top 10 and bottom 10, 20 total before deduplication
n_extreme_features <- 10L

slugify <- function(x) {
    x %>%
        tolower() %>%
        str_replace_all("[^[:alnum:]]+", "_") %>%
        str_replace_all("^_+|_+$", "")
}

# user config ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Preselect the sample set you want to analyse.
# analysis_samples <-
#     shorthouse_samples %>%
#     filter(
#         is_lung_cell_line,
#         !is.na(mutation_tokens)
#     )
analysis_samples <-
    shorthouse_samples %>%
    filter(
        !is.na(general_site),
        general_site == "Lung/Pleura"
    )

# - analysis_samples: the preselected dataframe
# - comparison_kind: "mutation_token" or "column_value"
# - contrast_column: e.g. "mutation_tokens" or "general_site"
# - contrast_numerator
# - contrast_denominator
# - contrast_denominator_mode: "all_others" or "value"



# comparison_group_var <- "comparison_group"
# comparison_kind <- "mutation_token"
# contrast_column <- "mutation_tokens"
# contrast_numerator <- "TP53"
# contrast_denominator <- "WT"
# contrast_denominator_mode <- "all_others"


comparison_group_var <- "comparison_group"

comparison_kind <- "mutation_token"
contrast_column <- "mutation_tokens"
contrast_numerator <- "EGFR"
contrast_denominator <- "WT"
contrast_denominator_mode <- "all_others"
plot_stat_mode <- "t_value"      # "adj_p" or "t_value"
plot_adj_p_threshold <- 0.05
plot_t_threshold <- 2
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

comparison_label <- paste0(
    slugify(contrast_numerator),
    "_vs_",
    slugify(contrast_denominator)
)
comparison_title <- paste0(contrast_numerator, " vs ", contrast_denominator)
direction_up_label <- paste0("Up_in_", slugify(contrast_numerator))
direction_down_label <- paste0("Down_in_", slugify(contrast_denominator))

results_dir <- "../Results/Differential_Analysis"
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

stopifnot(identical(rownames(shorthouse_intensities), rownames(shorthouse_samples)))

if (comparison_kind == "mutation_token") {
    stopifnot(contrast_denominator_mode == "all_others")

    analysis_samples <-
        analysis_samples %>%
        mutate(
            contrast_values = str_split(coalesce(as.character(.data[[contrast_column]]), ""), fixed(";")),
            contrast_values = lapply(contrast_values, str_trim),
            has_numerator = vapply(
                contrast_values,
                function(tokens) contrast_numerator %in% tokens,
                logical(1)
            ),
            !!comparison_group_var := factor(
                if_else(has_numerator, contrast_numerator, contrast_denominator),
                levels = c(contrast_denominator, contrast_numerator)
            )
        )

    source_counts <-
        analysis_samples %>%
        rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
        select(sample_id, contrast_values) %>%
        unnest(contrast_values) %>%
        filter(contrast_values != "") %>%
        distinct(sample_id, contrast_values) %>%
        count(contrast_values, name = "n_samples") %>%
        arrange(desc(n_samples), contrast_values)
} else if (comparison_kind == "column_value") {
    analysis_samples <-
        analysis_samples %>%
        mutate(
            contrast_value = as.character(.data[[contrast_column]])
        )

    if (contrast_denominator_mode == "all_others") {
        analysis_samples <-
            analysis_samples %>%
            mutate(
                !!comparison_group_var := factor(
                    if_else(contrast_value == contrast_numerator, contrast_numerator, contrast_denominator),
                    levels = c(contrast_denominator, contrast_numerator)
                )
            )
    } else if (contrast_denominator_mode == "value") {
        analysis_samples <-
            analysis_samples %>%
            filter(contrast_value %in% c(contrast_numerator, contrast_denominator)) %>%
            mutate(
                !!comparison_group_var := factor(
                    if_else(contrast_value == contrast_numerator, contrast_numerator, contrast_denominator),
                    levels = c(contrast_denominator, contrast_numerator)
                )
            )
    } else {
        stop("contrast_denominator_mode must be 'all_others' or 'value'.")
    }

    source_counts <-
        analysis_samples %>%
        count(.data[[contrast_column]], name = "n_samples") %>%
        arrange(desc(n_samples))
} else {
    stop("comparison_kind must be 'mutation_token' or 'column_value'.")
}

sample_summary <-
    analysis_samples %>%
    count(.data[[comparison_group_var]], name = "n_samples")

stopifnot(all(levels(analysis_samples[[comparison_group_var]]) %in% sample_summary[[comparison_group_var]]))

analysis_intensities <-
    shorthouse_intensities[
        rownames(analysis_samples),
        ,
        drop = FALSE
    ]

analysis_matrix_raw <- as.matrix(analysis_intensities)
storage.mode(analysis_matrix_raw) <- "numeric"

feature_positive_mask <- colSums(!is.finite(analysis_matrix_raw) | analysis_matrix_raw <= 0) == 0
analysis_matrix_positive <- analysis_matrix_raw[, feature_positive_mask, drop = FALSE]

feature_variance_mask <- apply(analysis_matrix_positive, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
analysis_matrix_filtered <- analysis_matrix_positive[, feature_variance_mask, drop = FALSE]

exprs_log2 <- log2(t(analysis_matrix_filtered))

feature_annotations <-
    shorthouse_features %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(feature_id = paste0("V", seq_len(n())))

sample_summary
source_counts

cat(
    "Retained features after filtering:", nrow(exprs_log2), "\n",
    "Removed for non-positive or non-finite values:", sum(!feature_positive_mask), "\n",
    "Removed for zero variance:", sum(!feature_variance_mask), "\n"
)

group_values <- analysis_samples[[comparison_group_var]]
sample_order <- order(group_values, analysis_samples$name)
analysis_samples_ordered <- analysis_samples[sample_order, , drop = FALSE]
exprs_log2_ordered <- exprs_log2[, rownames(analysis_samples_ordered), drop = FALSE]

plot_boxplot_df <-
    as.data.frame(t(exprs_log2_ordered)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = -sample_id,
        names_to = "feature_id",
        values_to = "log2_intensity"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
        analysis_samples_ordered %>%
            rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
            select(sample_id, name, all_of(comparison_group_var)),
        by = "sample_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id, levels = unique(sample_id)))

p_boxplot <-
    ggplot(plot_boxplot_df, aes(x = sample_id, y = log2_intensity, fill = .data[[comparison_group_var]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.15) +
    labs(
        title = "Log2 intensity distribution by selected samples",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Log2 intensity",
        fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top"
    )

print(p_boxplot)

ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, paste0(comparison_label, "_boxplot.png")),
    plot = p_boxplot,
    width = 12,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
)

pca_fit <- prcomp(t(exprs_log2), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_percent_var <- 100 * (pca_fit$sdev^2 / sum(pca_fit$sdev^2))

pca_df <-
    as.data.frame(pca_fit$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    left_join(
        analysis_samples %>%
            rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
            select(sample_id, name, all_of(comparison_group_var)),
        by = "sample_id"
    )

p_pca <-
    ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = .data[[comparison_group_var]], label = name)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text(size = 3, vjust = -0.6, check_overlap = TRUE) +
    labs(
        title = paste0("PCA of metabolite profiles: ", comparison_title),
        x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_percent_var[1], 1), "%)"),
        y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_percent_var[2], 1), "%)"),
        color = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_pca)

ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, paste0(comparison_label, "_pca.png")),
    plot = p_pca,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
)

sample_annotation <- analysis_samples_ordered %>% select(all_of(comparison_group_var))
rownames(sample_annotation) <- rownames(analysis_samples_ordered)

heatmap <- pheatmap(
    mat = cor(exprs_log2_ordered, method = "pearson"),
    annotation_col = sample_annotation,
    annotation_row = sample_annotation,
    main = paste0("Sample correlation heatmap: ", comparison_title),
    filename = file.path(results_dir, paste0(comparison_label, "_sample_correlation_heatmap.png")),
    width = 8,
    height = 8
)

group_factor <- analysis_samples[[comparison_group_var]]
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group_factor)
colnames(design) <- make.names(levels(group_factor), unique = TRUE)
contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
    contrasts = paste0(make.names(contrast_numerator), " - ", make.names(contrast_denominator)),
    levels = design
)

fit <- lmFit(exprs_log2, design)
fit <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

limma_results <-
    topTable(
        fit,
        coef = 1,
        number = Inf,
        sort.by = "P"
    ) %>%
    rownames_to_column("feature_id") %>%
    left_join(feature_annotations, by = "feature_id") %>%
    mutate(
        comparison_direction = case_when(
            logFC > 0 ~ direction_up_label,
            logFC < 0 ~ direction_down_label,
            TRUE ~ "Unchanged"
        ),
        neg_log10_adj_p = -log10(adj.P.Val)
    ) %>%
    arrange(adj.P.Val, desc(abs(logFC)))

if (plot_stat_mode == "adj_p") {
    limma_results <-
        limma_results %>%
        mutate(
            plot_metric_value = neg_log10_adj_p,
            plot_metric_flag = adj.P.Val < plot_adj_p_threshold
        )
} else if (plot_stat_mode == "t_value") {
    limma_results <-
        limma_results %>%
        mutate(
            plot_metric_value = abs(t),
            plot_metric_flag = abs(t) >= plot_t_threshold
        )
} else {
    stop("plot_stat_mode must be 'adj_p' or 't_value'.")
}

limma_results <-
    limma_results %>%
    mutate(plot_metric_label = if_else(plot_metric_flag, "Highlighted", "Background"))

plot_metric_legend <- if (plot_stat_mode == "adj_p") {
    paste0("adj.P.Val < ", plot_adj_p_threshold)
} else if (plot_stat_mode == "t_value") {
    paste0("|t| >= ", plot_t_threshold)
} else {
    stop("plot_stat_mode must be 'adj_p' or 't_value'.")
}

plot_metric_y_label <- if (plot_stat_mode == "adj_p") {
    "-log10 adjusted p-value"
} else {
    "Moderated t-statistic"
}

plot_metric_hline <- if (plot_stat_mode == "adj_p") {
    -log10(plot_adj_p_threshold)
} else if (plot_stat_mode == "t_value") {
    plot_t_threshold
} else {
    NULL
}

top_features <-
    limma_results %>%
    arrange(desc(logFC), adj.P.Val) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_extreme_features) %>%
    mutate(extreme_set = "Top")

bottom_features <-
    limma_results %>%
    arrange(logFC, adj.P.Val) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_extreme_features) %>%
    mutate(extreme_set = "Bottom")

extreme_features <-
    bind_rows(top_features, bottom_features) %>%
    distinct(feature_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

readr::write_csv(
    limma_results,
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("limma_", comparison_label, "_results.csv"))
)
readr::write_csv(
    top_features,
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("limma_", comparison_label, "_top_", n_extreme_features, ".csv"))
)
readr::write_csv(
    bottom_features,
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("limma_", comparison_label, "_bottom_", n_extreme_features, ".csv"))
)
readr::write_csv(
    extreme_features,
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("limma_", comparison_label, "_extreme_", 2 * n_extreme_features, ".csv"))
)

volcano_df <-
    limma_results %>%
    mutate(
        label = if_else(feature_id %in% extreme_features$feature_id, feature_id, NA_character_)
    )

p_volcano <-
    ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = logFC, y = plot_metric_value, color = plot_metric_label)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    geom_text(
        aes(label = label),
        size = 3,
        na.rm = TRUE,
        check_overlap = TRUE,
        vjust = -0.5
    ) +
    {if (!is.null(plot_metric_hline)) geom_hline(yintercept = plot_metric_hline, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") else NULL} +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Highlighted" = "#C44E52", "Background" = "#4C72B0")) +
    labs(
        title = paste0("Volcano plot: ", comparison_title),
        x = paste0("Log2 fold-change (", contrast_numerator, " - ", contrast_denominator, ")"),
        y = plot_metric_y_label,
        color = plot_metric_legend
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_volcano)

ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, paste0(comparison_label, "_volcano.png")),
    plot = p_volcano,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
)

p_ma <-
    ggplot(limma_results, aes(x = AveExpr, y = logFC, color = plot_metric_label)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Highlighted" = "#C44E52", "Background" = "#4C72B0")) +
    labs(
        title = paste0("MA plot: ", comparison_title),
        x = "Average log2 expression",
        y = paste0("Log2 fold-change (", contrast_numerator, " - ", contrast_denominator, ")"),
        color = plot_metric_legend
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_ma)

ggsave(
    filename = file.path(results_dir, paste0(comparison_label, "_MA.png")),
    plot = p_ma,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
)

extreme_feature_ids <- extreme_features$feature_id
heatmap_matrix <- exprs_log2_ordered[extreme_feature_ids, , drop = FALSE]
heatmap_labels <-
    extreme_features %>%
    arrange(match(feature_id, extreme_feature_ids)) %>%
    mutate(
        heatmap_label = if_else(
            !is.na(name) & name != "",
            paste0(feature_id, " | ", name),
            feature_id
        )
    ) %>%
    pull(heatmap_label)
rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- heatmap_labels

heatmap2 <- pheatmap(
    mat = heatmap_matrix,
    annotation_col = sample_annotation,
    scale = "row",
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    main = paste0(
        "Top ",
        n_extreme_features,
        " and bottom ",
        n_extreme_features,
        " differential features: ",
        comparison_title
    ),
    filename = file.path(
        results_dir,
        paste0(comparison_label, "_heatmap_top_bottom_", n_extreme_features, ".png")
    ),
    width = 10,
    height = 8
)

list(
    sample_summary = sample_summary,
    source_counts = source_counts,
    limma_results = limma_results,
    top_features = top_features,
    bottom_features = bottom_features,
    extreme_features = extreme_features
)
```

```{r}
# MPV dma
library(MetaProViz)

metadata_cols <- unique(c(comparison_group_var, contrast_column))

DMA_res <- MetaProViz::dma(
    data = analysis_intensities %>% .[order(rownames(.)), ],
    metadata_sample = analysis_samples[, metadata_cols, drop = FALSE] %>% .[order(rownames(.)), ],
    metadata_info = c(Conditions = comparison_group_var, Numerator = contrast_numerator, Denominator = contrast_denominator),
    pval = "wilcox.test"
)
```
